> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Answering the github-actions review summary, on #471 (top of the stack):

- **The card can disappear entirely**: fixed in [`1ff66f1b`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/commit/1ff66f1bab3dd4de9fa9a1c597122f436cc24c18). `show()` now resolves only once the card reports ready, and `false` on a failed load, a dead renderer or a 3 s timeout, so the page shows its in-app card instead.
- **Any window can ask for the card**: fixed in [`1ff66f1b`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/commit/1ff66f1bab3dd4de9fa9a1c597122f436cc24c18). `recording-ready:show` answers only the main window's renderer.

The pullfrog findings (Back re-asking for the card, the clipped shadow) are answered in their inline threads.
